stopTypeFor.readPage: Reading a page of the book together, with the sentences on screen.
stopTypeFor.storyPieces: The parts of a story — title, characters, setting — as cards to tap.
stopTypeFor.wordCards: New words, each with what it means and a sentence using it.
stopTypeFor.move: A short movement break: actions the child does with their body.
stopTypeFor.explain: Teaching a skill: an explanation and a worked example or two.
stopTypeFor.choice: One question, a few answers, exactly one of them right.
stopTypeFor.trueFalse: One statement the child decides is true or false.
stopTypeFor.sequence: A run of numbers with a gap the child fills in.
stopTypeFor.count: Counting objects in groups and picking the total.
stopTypeFor.compare: Deciding which of two numbers is bigger, smaller or the same.
stopTypeFor.sound: Hearing a sound and picking the letter or word it belongs to.
stopTypeFor.word: Hearing a word and picking it out of a few.
stopTypeFor.readTap: Reading a line and tapping the part the question asks for.
stopTypeFor.multiSelect: Tapping a set number of the right answers.
stopTypeFor.selectAll: Tapping every right answer, however many there are.
stopTypeFor.match: Joining pairs — a word to its picture, a sum to its answer.
stopTypeFor.order: Putting things in the right order.
stopTypeFor.trace: Tracing a letter or number with a finger.
stopTypeFor.retell: Telling the story back in the child’s own words.
stopTypeFor.openAnswer: An open question the child answers in their own words.
stopTypeFor.writeSentence: Finishing a sentence by writing the missing part.
stopTypeFor.exitTicket: Three last questions that close the lesson.
